Recover retained facts in isolation only from authoritative evidence; preserve raw events and provenance. Supply an unrecoverable inventory and preview any proposed backfill. No live operator backfill, mission replay, synthetic measurement, hidden affected mission or missing-to-zero conversion is authorized.
